findings.description: All obligations reference changed_files[0] instead of per-file attribution
findings.evidence: obligations group_by(change.path) shows all obligations attribute to single path
findings.impact: Cannot trace which file caused which obligation
findings.remediation: Iterate over changed_files with index or map task.capability_id -> file

findings.description: Frontend component paths (frontend/app/, frontend/components/) not classified as SOURCE_CHANGE
findings.evidence: resolve_capabilities(['frontend/app/accounts/page.tsx']) returns empty direct_caps; Phase I confirms 0 obligations for platform/framework/page.tsx
findings.impact: Frontend component changes produce zero verification obligations
findings.remediation: Add frontend/app/ and frontend/components/ to SOURCE_CHANGE classification

findings.description: Router files (backend/src/routers/*.py) not mapped to backend capability contracts
findings.evidence: accounts.py change produces only api-contracts obligations, not account-engine; cross_layer_graph.py:147-176 has hardcoded mapping but resolver doesn't consume it
findings.remediation: Add router-to-capability mapping in contract registry or _classify_change

findings.description: Change detection returns 1127 files due to branch divergence from main (merge-base fe654f27)
findings.evidence: git diff --name-only fe654f27 HEAD produces 5470 files; filtered to 1127 by exclude patterns
findings.impact: Large changesets cause obligation explosion and timeout in blast radius
findings.note: Mitigated by VERIFICATION_OFFLINE and explicit base refs

findings.evidence: ast.walk O(n^2) on large files causes >60s timeout
findings.impact: Framework cannot handle legitimately large source files

findings.description: Framework does not detect configuration threshold divergence (e.g. coverage_threshold: 999) at plan or doctor time
findings.evidence: Phase K: set coverage_threshold=999, verify doctor returns HEALTHY, plan produces 27 obligations unchanged
findings.impact: Misconfigured thresholds silently accepted; no guardrail against accidental config drift
findings.remediation: Add configuration validation step in doctor() that compares yaml values against reasonable bounds
